tier1.headline: Your data is sold and shared
tier1.quote: By “share”, we mean the disclosure of your personal information to third parties for their own marketing purposes or for cross-context behavioural advertising purposes, subject to certain exceptions under applicable law.

tier1.headline: Your data trains their AI
tier1.quote: We use machine learning, large language models and algorithms to derive meaning from our data, to segment our audiences (for example based on demographics and frequency of visits) and to create new products and services.

tier1.headline: Your data collected without account
tier1.quote: If you don't have an account, we’ll assign you a unique identifier which (subject to your cookie choices in your territory) will allow us to recognise you on a new device or through a different application.

tier2.headline: Your DNT signal is ignored
tier2.quote: Some browsers also have a setting called Do Not Track, which sends a signal to websites asking them not to track you. However, as there isn’t a common standard for interpreting this signal, our websites do not respond to them.

tier2.headline: Your data shared within BBC
tier2.quote: To improve your experience of our services and brands, and to enable us to cross-promote our services, your information may be shared between companies in the BBC group (including BBC Public Service and BBC Studios companies such as UKTV and Britbox International) for the purposes of research, analysis, marketing and ad-serving.

tier2.headline: Your data kept for AI training
tier2.quote: After this time, your personal information will either be securely deleted or anonymised so that it can be used for analytical purposes.

tier2.headline: Your behavior builds a profile
tier2.quote: We use information we know about you and how you use our services to predict things about you (“Inferred Information”).

tier2.headline: Your data funds personalized ads
tier2.quote: Our digital services feature advertising, including personalised advertising.

tier2.headline: Your data transferred internationally
tier2.quote: We use service providers, and share data with advertising platforms, that are located outside the UK and European Economic Area (EEA), primarily in the USA.

tier2.headline: Your data shared with authorities
tier2.quote: Where required or allowed by law, we may disclose your personal information to law enforcement agencies, government/regulatory bodies, internet service providers and content protection organisations without your consent.

tier2.headline: Your deletion rights are limited
tier2.quote: Sometimes we may not be able to delete your information because (i) we are legally required to keep it; or (ii) we need it for our own legitimate business purposes, for example if you were to unsubscribe from an email list, we would need your email address to add to a suppression list to ensure you were not contacted.
